description.short: Save a Teams message to BTY so you don't lose it.
description.full: Adds one action to the message menu: Save to BTY. The message you pick is saved to your BTY "Saved for later" list with a link back to the original conversation. It does not become a commitment, a deadline or a task until you decide it should. BTY reads no other messages.

commands.title: Save to BTY
commands.description: Save this message to BTY so you don't lose it.
